item.title: Dynamite rating for 02/11/2026
item.description: Dynamite this week drew 604,000 viewers, down 50,000 viewers from last week’s broadcast. The show had a 0.12 rating in 18-49, down 0.03 from the prior week but their second best number of the year so far. Dynamite was #9 in the top 50 cable chart for the night.
